name: cafe-mehras-full-project
description: کافه مهراس — full-stack café website: React + Tailwind frontend, Express + MongoDB backend, admin panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start" "npm --prefix admin-panel start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && CI=true npm --prefix frontend test -- --watchAll=false
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin-panel run build
